messages:
Hannah: Heads-up: product is scheduling v1 deprecation + model alias swap next month. We need a short migration guide, sanitized examples, and targeted PRs to update sample repos.
Ravi: Copy that. I'll inventory the quickstarts and samples for obvious PII and hardcoded model names.
Marta: For SDKs there's a breaking rename: embeddings param `dimension` -> `vector_dim` and the callsite moves from `client.createEmbedding` to `client.embeddings.create`. I'll draft side-by-side snippets for JS/Python.
Omar: I'll update the samples with new model alias `redwood-q-7b` replacing `open-quant-7b`. Small table updates in quickstart.
Hannah: Legal asked we replace any plausible real names/emails with tokens and add a footer line: "Examples sanitized for privacy." Keep the note brief.
Ravi: Plan: 1) grep + script to replace email patterns, 2) manual pass for any human-readable names, 3) open small PRs with preview builds. Branch `docs/sanitize-1867`.
Marta: Snippet draft (short):
```py
# v1
res = client.createEmbedding(model="redwood-embed-v1", dimension=1536, input="text")
# v2
res = client.embeddings.create(model="redwood-embed-v2", vector_dim=1536, input="text")
```
Omar: CI note: doc-runner currently expects v1 endpoints. QA-bot: will fail until we add a temporary shim or make runner accept both.
QA-bot: docs-smoke: failing on `createEmbedding` calls. Recommend shim mapping v1->v2 in `tools/doc-runner/adapters`.
Hannah: Assignments: Ravi (grep & sanitize script + PRs), Marta (snippets + migration guide skeleton), Omar (samples update + model table), QA-bot (smoke runs + final verification), Hannah (legal sign-off + redirects).
Ravi: Timeline: quick PRs tomorrow, full merge by Thursday, banners on staging Friday.
Marta: I'll include a compatibility section explaining the alias swap and a curl/TS/py quick example.
Omar: I'll avoid touching historical archived pages; instead add redirects and a deprecation banner linking to the migration guide.
legal: We'll prioritize reviewing the sanitize PRs; please ping once they're up.
Hannah: Great. Drop PR links here as you open them and mark items off the migration checklist in the guide. :thumbsup:
